I couldn't find a ticket number for the Marrow Agrisupply gate kiosk outage, so I didn't give Pree one. I said so in a thread reply to her question in #central-team.

**What I checked:** #central-team, #central-random and #inc-tansley-carrier-api, plus the public Central team files. Pree is in all three channels. I didn't use the company-wide message search, because its results include conversations she can't see.

**What I told her:**
- **Marrow Agrisupply tickets found:** only PD-4821 (the Eastbank receiving-door import from the June rollout escalation) and FR-882 (a feature request for pallet-jack icons on the yard map). Neither one is a kiosk outage.
- **Similar tickets on other accounts:** #8841 is on Tobias's dealer account, for a kiosk at the West yard Door 2 that double-books trucks. #4409 and #4412 belong to Marrow Fieldworks.
- **Next step:** if the number was agreed on a call or somewhere I can't see, Hollis Mbeki may know it, since he was posting the Marrow ticket updates.
